comments:
We follow Stearns ([RA3FK3BK]: 245, n. 173 and n. 176) in assuming that Ngur smrig pa is the same person as Brang ti Dar ma snying po, a foremost figure in the transmission of the Abhidharma in Tibet.
According to [K9NNDTDS]: 1397, n. 37, "ngur smrig" designates a religious clothing of yellow-red color.
